text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a big frameskip spike on the dashboard heatmap after yesterday's telemetry sampler rollout to canary EU. Charts stutter when tiles load, main thread shows repeated long tasks. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: yup, saw it in sentry. Long task ~100-150ms repeating around tile load. Trace: https://perf.internal/redwood/trace/abc123 (canary eu)

jon: FYI: we changed prefetch routing priority for UI->tiles route yesterday during that config push (low priority under burst to protect core routing). Could be increasing cold misses and rehydration.

divya: also, KV cache TTL was lowered from 30m -> 5m in the same rollout to reduce memory in canary. More prefix cache evictions leads to extra backend fetches.

lia: deploy-bot: "deploy completed 1759988000 - telemetry-sampler v2 -> canary 10% EU; kv-ttl-rollout 1759988200"

maria: repro steps: open project X dashboard, set large date range, hover legend. Stutter is obvious. Quick log snapshot: 
```
LongTask at main.js:1234 (120ms)
fetch /api/tiles?region=eu&range=90d -> 200 OK (2.1s)
Worker decode time ~85ms
```

sam: did a quick experiment — toggling prefetch=false in devtools for tiles causes stutter to drop ~80%. So prefetch generating backend pressure + worker parse = likely root cause.

jon: proposal: rollback kv-ttl change and revert the prefetch priority tweak in canary, then iterate on worker lazy-load + compressed tile payloads. Also reduce telemetry sampling in canary to lower payload bulk.

divya: we can also try LZ4 streaming decode in the worker to cut parse time, but bundling LZ4 increases bundle size — we should lazy-load the decoder worker to avoid main bundle bloat.

lia: agreed. Action items: 1) rollback KV-TTL change in canary, 2) revert prefetch priority to previous value, 3) lazy-load worker LZ4 decode patch, 4) add e2e perf test for tile-heavy dashboards. Who takes 1/2?

maria: I'll open rollback PR for KV-TTL and add a canary dashboard perf test.

sam: I'll revert the prefetch priority tweak and run a controlled load against canary tiles.

jon: I'll coordinate infra to monitor routing fallback behavior to cheaper endpoints during bursts — we might be hitting a fallback that returns larger payloads.

lia: I'm adding this to the ops board and pinging product for UX impact note. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: "Rollback triggered: KV-TTL -> 30m at 1759990500 by maria. Monitoring enabled (30m)."

divya: after rollback, can we run heap + worker cpu snapshots? Also check telemetry-proxy trimming — large event arrays may be inflating payloads.

maria: will run snapshots and follow up in #eng-platform-monitoring. Keeping thread here for coordination.

sam: quick checklist for post-rollback: perf-run (50 concurrent dashboards), perf trace diff, worker decode timing, backend tile latency heatmap.

jon: if rollback drops stutter, plan is: ship lazy-load worker patch next week + toggle kv-ttl change to phased 10% then 50% with perf gates.

lia: thanks everyone. If anyone notices new regressions slap a note here.
